So we can create separate test methods that construct appropriate blueprint manually within test.

We must not modify @BeforeEach etc. but can create local blueprint variables inside test methods.

Then call JsonSchemaFactory.builder(blueprint) and verify that returned Builder has non-null schemaLoadersBuilder (different instance) and schemaMappersBuilder null.

3. only schemaMappersBuilder non-null. Similar using schemaMappers method.

4. both internal builders non-null. Use both.

Use builder.metaSchema(mock1).metaSchema(mock2).build(). Then copy builder, then modify copy's metaSchemas via reflection (builder.metaSchemas map). Ensure blueprint unchanged.

6. null defaultMetaSchemaIri handling. Build blueprint with defaultMetaSchemaIri null via builder().defaultMetaSchemaIri(null).build(). Then copy builder and verify defaultMetaSchemaIri null.

8. copy of yamlMapper when jsonMapper null. Build blueprint with jsonMapper(null) (deprecated method) and yamlMapper set. Copy and verify yamlMapper same and jsonMapper null.

Ensure blueprint metaSchemas map stores normalized key "http://example.com/meta". After copy, check builder's metaSchemas map contains normalized key.

Use reflection to get builder.schemaLoadersBuilder and inspect its internal map? Might be complex; we can just verify that after building copyFactory, the custom loader works. For schemaLoadersBuilder, we can test that copyFactory can load custom schema. Already similar to earlier test. For schemaMappersBuilder, maybe we can test that a custom mapper is used when loading schema? Might be heavy. Simpler: verify that builder's internal builder objects are not same as blueprint's (different identity) but not null.

11. null blueprint parameter: expect NullPointerException when calling JsonSchemaFactory.builder(null). Use assertThrows.

12. blueprint with null metaSchemas map: Need to create a JsonSchemaFactory where metaSchemas is null. However builder's constructor expects a ConcurrentMap param; but the Builder's metaSchemas map is always initialized to new ConcurrentHashMap. To set null, we may need to use reflection to set the private field metaSchemas of the factory to null after building. Build blueprint normally then set field via reflection to null, then call builder(blueprint) expecting NPE.

15. blueprint with faulty schemaLoadersBuilder: Need subclass of SchemaLoaders.Builder that overrides with to throw IllegalArgumentException. Might be tricky; we can create a mock of SchemaLoaders.Builder using Mockito that throws when with is called. Then set blueprint.schemaLoadersBuilder via reflection to that mock. Then call builder(blueprint) expecting IllegalArgumentException.

But we need to import Mockito and use mock.

Similarly for schemaMappersBuilder.
